# GNK ASG — Final Pre-launch Audit

Status: locked preparation. This file is not part of the public portal build.

## Audit objective

Perform a final preparation review before the first publication package is created and reviewed.

## Critical activation checks

### 1. Scheduled publication workflow

Result: no active daily publication workflow was found at the expected workflow path.

Decision: safe. No automatic publication should run from that path.

### 2. Public activation switch

Result: public activation is disabled.

Decision: safe. The system is still in locked preparation mode.

## Main risk before first release

The main risk is not technical preparation. The main risk is publishing before visual, metadata, mobile and link checks are complete.

## Required before first public publication

- Create one complete draft article package.
- Create preview image and mobile crop note.
- Prepare canonical URL.
- Prepare meta title and description.
- Prepare internal links.
- Prepare short public text and business text.
- Review desktop preview.
- Review mobile preview.
- Confirm that homepage remains unchanged unless explicitly approved.
- Confirm dashboard status is truthful.

## Do not do yet

- Do not activate scheduled publication.
- Do not connect public navigation to unfinished routes.
- Do not add homepage hero changes.
- Do not mark external distribution as active.
- Do not show unfinished dashboard status publicly.

## Recommended next action

Prepare the first complete publication package in draft-only mode:

Working title: How Artificial Intelligence Helps Users Understand a Corporate Portal

Primary story: GNK ASG and GNK DINAMO Ltd.

Personal layer: group owner, director, author or approver only if accurate and discreet.

Initial public position: preview-only until desktop and mobile review.

Ready to prepare first draft package.
